info.title: PivotBank API
info.summary: Bank statement PDF to structured transactions, with the statement's own balance check.
info.description: POST a bank statement PDF and get back every transaction as JSON: date, description, money out, money in, running balance, the page it was printed on, and whether the statement's own running balance vouches for it. One endpoint. Requires a Pro subscription and an API key from https://pivotbank.app/account/api-keys. Every response carries X-Pages-Left, the pages remaining in the plan's monthly allowance. Every response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Policy for the plan's monthly page allowance. The API is versioned in the path; a version is never changed in place, and a retiring version would carry Deprecation and Sunset headers for at least six months.

post.summary: Convert a bank statement PDF to transactions
post.description: Reads a digital (text-layer) bank statement PDF of up to 15 MB and returns its transactions in printed order. The reading is checked against the statement's own running balances; `reconciliation.verified` is true only when opening balance plus every row lands exactly on the closing balance, and each row carries its own `check`. Scanned statements are not supported on this endpoint. Each call spends the statement's page count from the plan's monthly allowance; the balance after the call is in the X-Pages-Left header. A call that fails before parsing costs nothing.

schema.description: The statement PDF as the raw request body.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this is the kept answer to an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

422.description: Not a readable PDF (`unparseable`, nothing charged), or an Idempotency-Key reused with a different file (`idempotency_key_reused`).

405.description: A method other than POST. `code` is `method_not_allowed`; the Allow header says POST.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string up to 255 visible characters. A retry with the same key and the same file within 24 hours gets the first successful answer back, marked Idempotent-Replayed: true, and is not charged again. The same key with a different file is a 422 with code idempotency_key_reused. Errors are not kept: nothing is charged on an error, so a retry runs again.

get.summary: What the API offers and how to get in
get.description: The API's front door: the endpoints, the spec, and the auth walkthrough, as JSON.

apiKey.description: An API key, `pvb_live_...`, created at https://pivotbank.app/account/api-keys and shown once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer pvb_live_...` (an `x-api-key` header is also accepted). Keys belong to a Pro account; a key on any other account is refused with 403.

X-Pages-Left.description: Pages left in the plan's allowance for the current period after this call, plan pages plus any top-up. 0 on a 402.

RateLimit-Limit.description: The plan's premium pages per period.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Pages left in the period after this call.

RateLimit-Policy.description: The window, in the RateLimit-Policy form: `<limit>;w=<seconds>`.

period.description: The statement period as printed, when found.

pageCount.description: Pages in the PDF, which is what the call cost.

Reconciliation.description: The statement's own arithmetic applied to the reading. `verified` is the one field to gate on: true means opening balance plus every credit minus every debit lands exactly on the closing balance.

status.description: `unavailable` means the statement prints too few running balances to check; that is not verified.

difference.description: closing minus expectedClosing; 0 when it balances.

date.description: As printed on the statement, e.g. `06 Mar 2025` or `03/01/2026`.

balance.description: Running balance after this row, negative when overdrawn, null when the row prints none.

page.description: The page of the PDF this row was printed on, 1-based. Inferred from the figures; absent when it could not be told.

check.description: What the running balances say about this row: `ok` follows from the row before, `gap` does not (this row or a neighbour is missing, doubled or the wrong way round), `uncovered` sits above the first or below the last printed balance and is unchecked.

error.description: What went wrong, in a sentence, with the fix where there is one.

docs.description: Where to read about the API.

mcp.description: The MCP servers: one to act, one for the docs, and the server card.

BadRequest.description: No file in the `file` field, an unreadable body, or an empty one. `code` is `no_file`, `unreadable` or `empty`.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or revoked key. `code` is `missing_key` or `invalid_key`. Carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="PivotBank API"`.

PaymentRequired.description: The plan has no pages left this period. `code` is `no_pages_left`; X-Pages-Left is 0. Top-ups at https://pivotbank.app/account/billing.

Forbidden.description: The key belongs to an account without an active Pro subscription. `code` is `pro_required`.

TooLarge.description: Over 15 MB, judged from Content-Length before the body is read. `code` is `too_large`. A PDF of more than 500 pages is also a 413, with `code` `too_many_pages`.

Unparseable.description: Not a readable PDF, or a scanned one with no text layer. `code` is `unparseable`. Nothing is charged.

ServerError.description: Something broke on our side. `code` is `internal`. Nothing is charged; try again.

Default.description: Any other failure, in the same shape.
